title: Claude Opus 4.8: Smarter, Same Price
description:
Anthropic launched Claude Opus 4.8, their best model yet for coding, agents and proper hard work. The catch? The price didn't move. Same $5 in, $25 out per million tokens. And the fast version runs at 2.5x the speed.

Better tools, same bill. What's the first thing you'd hand it? #short
transcript: Anthropic just launched its smartest model yet and the price didn't move. It's called Opus 4.8. Better at coding, better at agents, better at proper hard work than the version before it. The kind of work you'd hand to a sharp assistant. Drafting, digging through research, working a messy problem end to end. It got better at all of it. Now here's the strange part. Normally these things cost more every time they get better. This one didn't. It cost exactly what the last version did. Not a penny more. And there's a fast version that runs at two and a half times the speed. So the AI doing your actual work just got sharper and faster and your bill stayed exactly where it was. What's the first thing you'd hand it?
